character.motivation: Still remembers whom his ferry left behind. Wants to cross the pond again with somebody who can tell him when to stop.
character.voice: Slow and specific. Counts things when he runs out of words.
character.backstory: Hollis ferried people away from the low bank until the boat was full. He can still remember who was waiting when he pushed off, and he stopped taking passengers once the crossing closed.
character.quest_hook: Help Hollis and Bea prepare one return crossing, then let a former passenger choose when and where to turn back.

dialogue.introduction: I used to bring everyone across. People remember the one winter I couldn't.
dialogue.friendship: The ferry was already full. I still counted the people on the bank after we pushed off.
dialogue.supper: I ate outside. I could hear them laugh from the bench. That was close enough for this year.
dialogue.hearing: I'll take anyone across who wants to see the old bank. They can tell me when to turn around.
dialogue.favorite_gift: Ah. That size used to turn up right beside the oar.
dialogue.disliked_gift: I have three turnips in the cupboard and a fourth in my coat. Ask Ada.

routine.home_context: Lives beside Bea and Ren at the quiet end of the bank, near water without a passenger crossing.
